paths.description: Directory and file paths used by HED

vardir.description: Base directory for HED runtime and temporary data

pidfile.description: Full path to PID file for the HED service

limits.description: Performance and resource limits for the HED service

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for request handling (recommend: CPU cores or slightly more)

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of pending requests in queue

connection_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for idle client connections before being closed

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging (not recommended in production)

metrics_enabled.description: Enable collection and reporting of internal health metrics

allowed_hosts.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses permitted to query the health endpoint

endpoints.description: List of HTTP endpoints to monitor for health status

name.description: Unique identifier for this endpoint (used as section name)

timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for each health check request

method.description: HTTP method to use (e.g., GET, POST). Defaults to GET if omitted

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status code (e.g., 200). Defaults to 200 if omitted

insecure.description: Allow insecure TLS connections (e.g., self-signed certs). Only for HTTPS endpoints
